in_hebrew.name: Mavra
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mavra הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Mavra was a goddess of the earth, fertility, and abundance. In Christianity, the name Mavra is derived from the Greek word 'mavros,' meaning 'black.' This name can be given to a girl symbolizing the depth and richness of grace and beauty.
